selection: November 18 BTC daily Up/Down from first available Phase55 coverage frame; displayed Up bid and ask depths 53 and 1603; no trade or return used
relationship: Down is the verified mutually exclusive complement of Up in the same condition. A rise in executable Down bid warns against a resting Up bid. Mechanical mirroring may provide zero warning.
baseline: Retired Phase42 passive bid thesis, with shared trade-only fill correction replacing the crossed ask proxy. Best Up bid entry, fresh spread >=0.02, max 0.20, 5 shares, one lot and one resting order, 500 USD cash, no shorts. Both arms exit via executable bid covering entry and fee or after 120s. Normal resting order lifetime 30 seconds.
candidate_only_change: Cancel the Up bid once executable Down bid rises at least 0.02 above its value at order acceptance; Down best bid must support 5 shares. After effective cancel re-enter only when Down best bid retreats below that threshold, or after the ordinary 30s order lifetime, whichever first.
causality: receive UTC for decisions; exchange UTC for whether passive matching occurred before effective cancellation; unmatched clock/order or missing data censored
queue: two scenarios: zero ahead and full displayed depth ahead at acceptance; never count anonymous cancellations, absent trade size, crossed quotes, or quote touches as fills; only SELL aggressive Up maker-price trades; partial fills capped by printed quantity
fees: verified dated native curve for liquidation, passive maker fee zero, rebates zero in both arms
rule: primary full-depth ahead, also zero ahead; no significance claim from one market; remove the one market and largest paired gain
